name: Spatial4D-Bench
description: Spatial4D-Bench evaluates models' ability to understand and reason about dynamic 3D scenes over time (4D): spatial relationships, object motion, and temporal consistency. Tasks typically involve spatio-temporal prediction, scene understanding, and QA or matching across time steps using multimodal inputs (e.g., point clouds, RGB frames and temporal annotations). The benchmark focuses on robustness of temporal reasoning and physical plausibility across changing scenes.
evaluation_method: composite (accuracy for classification/QA tasks; mean IoU / displacement error for spatial/trajectory predictions; task-specific metrics combined into summary scores)
general_score_metric: composite_score (task-specific metrics aggregated, e.g., accuracy + displacement/error-based measures)
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face as a niche dataset for spatio-temporal reasoning in 3D; modest adoption so far within specialized research groups.
